text:
Riya (Sales): FYI incoming SIG/CAIQ from CloudHarbor, they want answers + evidence by EOD next Wed. link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1CloudHarborSIG
Jules (SE): Got it. Is this for the POC or the later contract?
Riya (Sales): POC first — they asked for security contact + where we'll store evidence, and whether BYOK is supported for the POC environment.
Tom (Security): I'll take primary on the questionnaire. Quick Q: do they mean customer-managed KMS in Dedicated, or do they want a short-term BYOK for Hosted POC?
Riya (Sales): They said "POC with sensitive data" and repeated BYOK a couple times. Sales note: customer legal team is strict about key control.
Nina (Legal): If they bring their own key for the POC, we need the standard DPA addendum and a short checklist on access controls. I can draft the addendum but need the KMS model details from Security.
Tom (Security): Understood. For Hosted POC we can offer a temp KMS integration with limited scope. For Dedicated it's standard. I'll document the trade-offs in the response.
Leo (Support): Where should we drop the evidence artifacts (logs, config screenshots)? Preference from ops: s3://redwood-evidence/cloudharbor/sig-3629876543/ (internal bucket)
Jules (SE): I'll upload config snippets and a minimal demo run output there tonight.
sec-bot: NOTE: New SIG intake recorded 3629876543 — SLA: 7 days for full response, 3 days for ack. Assigned: unclaimed.
Riya (Sales): Can Security claim so we don't miss the 3-day ack?
Tom (Security): Claiming now. I'll fill controls matrix for CAIQ sections 1-4 today and flag anything requiring engineering.
Jules (SE): Heads-up — they asked about network isolation for the POC. For Hosted we have VPC peering + private endpoints; I'll add the exact network diagram.
Tom (Security): Two actionable items for Eng/Platform: 1) confirm KMS BYOK feasibility for short-lived keys in Hosted POC, 2) confirm that audit logs for the demo are retained in the S3 path above. @eng-platform please chime in if you see this.
Riya (Sales): Also pricing note from customer: if BYOK required we might need a small Dedicated quote — sales to follow up after security signoff.
Nina (Legal): Once Tom posts the control answers, I'll attach the DPA addendum and stamp with legal. Prefer GitHub PR for traceability.
Tom (Security): Uploaded draft answers + evidence list to s3://redwood-evidence/cloudharbor/sig-3629876543/answers-v1.md and linked in the drive folder.
Jules (SE): Uploaded network diagram (png) and POC run log (tail) to the same bucket.
Leo (Support): I added a short runbook for the POC under the bucket: runbook.md — includes rollback steps.
Riya (Sales): Great — I'll tell the customer we've acknowledged and that Security is taking the lead. Will update the POC schedule after confirm on BYOK path. :thumbsup:
Tom (Security): Next step: I'll finish CAIQ sections and call out any items that require enterprise (engineer/legal) action. ETA: tomorrow noon.
